items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1972-09-13
items.q: I played with many jobs with the d'eat... With Billy. D.D. and Billy. Yes, indeed. He played with them a lot.

ctx.x: Yeah. I told them I got a cornet player. I'd like to be all the young. His name, I forgot his name too. He used to live right across the street from where I used to go around and go. You know, even the d'eat was there. I played with many jobs with the d'eat. He used to play around about four or four or two together. Yeah. With Billy.
